records.title: Preparation for Careers in Biomedical Sciences Seminar
records.header: TBIOMD 199 Preparation for Careers in Biomedical Sciences Seminar (1)
records.text: TBIOMD 199 Preparation for Careers in Biomedical Sciences Seminar (1) Introduces students to requirements of professional medical, dental, veterinary, and pharmacy school. Explores key issues in healthcare, and exposes students to potential career pathways in preparation for completing the pre-medical/dental/veterinary/pharmacy (pre-MVDP) program. Cannot be taken for credit if credit received for TESC 199. Credit/no-credit only.

records.title: Introduction to Public Health
records.header: TBIOMD 201 Introduction to Public Health (5) NSc/SSc
records.text: TBIOMD 201 Introduction to Public Health (5) NSc/SSc Introduces students to the field of public health, its history and functions, and to the determinants of major causes of death and disease through lecture, small-group discussion, case studies, and local and global examples. Course overlaps with: SPH 380; SPH 381; and BHS 201.

records.title: Foundational Skills in Biomedical Sciences
records.header: TBIOMD 310 Foundational Skills in Biomedical Sciences (5) NSc
records.text: TBIOMD 310 Foundational Skills in Biomedical Sciences (5) NSc Trains students to read and process existing scientific literature, formulate a hypothesis, collect data to test a hypothesis, write-up research findings, and present findings orally utilizing both individual and group work. Prerequisite: a minimum grade of 2.0 in T BIOL 130; and a minimum grade of 2.0 in T CHEM 152.

records.title: Special Topics in Biomedical Sciences
records.header: TBIOMD 485 Special Topics in Biomedical Sciences (2-5, max. 15)
records.text: TBIOMD 485 Special Topics in Biomedical Sciences (2-5, max. 15) Explores a specific area of biological research in-depth through supervised readings and discussion of peer-reviewed scientific articles. Specific topics vary by instructor(s) and iteration. Prerequisite: a minimum grade of 2.0 in either T BIOL 301, T BIOL 302, T BIOL 303, T BIOL 304, T BIOL 305, T BIOL 313, T BIOL 314, T BIOL 323, T BIOL 325, T BIOL 331, T BIOL 340, or T CHEM 405; recommended: TBIOMD 310.

records.title: Critical Reading in Biomedical Sciences Literature
records.header: TBIOMD 492 Critical Reading in Biomedical Sciences Literature (3) NSc
records.text: TBIOMD 492 Critical Reading in Biomedical Sciences Literature (3) NSc Critically read the biomedical sciences literature and identify major strengths and weaknesses in reports of experimental and observational biomedical studies in this intensive seminar. This will include gaining expertise in selected biomedical research or clinical techniques, interpreting statistical results, writing peer reviews, and critically reviewing a body of evidence to make a logical argument from an evidence-based viewpoint. Prerequisite: TBIOMD 310 and TMATH 110.
